references.text: Describes the southern border of Israel's land, including the Wilderness of Zin and the region of Edom, which corresponds to Judah's southern border.
Explains how the land was to be distributed by casting lots among the tribes, as was done for Judah.
God's command to distribute the land by casting lots according to the clans, which is fulfilled here for the tribe of Judah.
The introduction to the distribution of the land in Canaan by casting lots for the tribes of Israel.
Continuation of the lot-casting for the remaining tribes, using the same method that was applied to Judah.
Jacob's blessing over Judah, which foretold the tribe's prominent position among the tribes of Israel.
The Wilderness of Zin is mentioned as part of the area explored by the spies.
